postconditions.expression: all(output[i] != '-' or output[i-1] == '-' or int(output[i-1]) % 2 == 0 for i in range(1, len(output)))
postconditions.description: Dashes are inserted only between two odd numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(digit) % 2 != 0 for digit in output if digit != '-')

The output does not start with a dash.
